module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureTargets
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEqualityProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedCommonLeastProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedMinimumProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowSyntaxProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeOpenSyntaxProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (programRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof (conjunctionRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof (formulaRelabelComposition)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z sucRelabel zRelabel)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeOpenSyntaxProof (unaryRename rawConsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowSyntaxProof (windowRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (quadInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edgeGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (edgeTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEqualityProof
  (auxiliaryTermRename exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedMinimumProof
  (exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedCommonLeastProof
  (exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedCommonLeast)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

private theorem edgeRename {α β : Type} (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b : OTerm α)
    (j : α → β) :
    (edgeGraph X W ctx ty a b).relabel j =
      edgeGraph X W (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
  simp only [edgeGraph,programRename,edgeTape,quadInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

/-- The five non-measure parent reports, moved into a continuation context. -/
private structure Moved {α β : Type} (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β)
    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α) : Prop where
  syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (unary TV (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary TV (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
  ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (unary G (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary G (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
  argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (windowAt W (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))
  fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j)))
  gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (g.relabel j) (f.relabel j)))

private theorem move {α β : Type} {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β) (keep : ∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ)
    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α)
    (syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)))
    (ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary G (suc z) dom ⊓ unary G (suc z) cod)))
    (argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)))
    (fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)))
    (gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f))) :
    Moved body Δ j TV G D W ctx dom cod f g arg := by
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  have fg' := renameInto fg j Δ keep
  have gf' := renameInto gf j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  simp only [edgeRename,rawConsRename] at fg' gf'
  exact ⟨syn',ty',argument',fg',gf'⟩

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg m P W D X a b syn ty argument fg gf cf cg
  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent V TV M M0 B T s body α Γ
    dom cod f g arg m (edgeGraph X W ctx cod a b) cf cg
  intro β j Δ p keep pa pb
  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument fg gf
  have pa' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pa
  have pb' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pb
  have e := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedEdge V TV M M0 B T base s body β Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) p
    mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf pa' pb'
  show Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    ((edgeGraph X W ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg)).relabel j))
  rw [edgeRename,auxiliaryTermRename,auxiliaryTermRename]
  exact e

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureCommonLeast :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureCommonLeast := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg m goal P W D X a b syn ty argument fg gf
    cf cg k
  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent V TV M M0 B T s body α Γ
    dom cod f g arg m goal cf cg
  intro β j Δ p keep pa pb
  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument fg gf
  have pa' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pa
  have pb' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pb
  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedCommonLeast V TV M M0 B T base s body β Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) p
    (goal.relabel j) mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf pa' pb'
  intro γ i Θ x retain la lb
  have both (q : Formula α) (hq : q ∈ Γ) : q.relabel (i ∘ j) ∈ Θ := by
    rw [← formulaRelabelComposition j i q]
    exact retain (q.relabel j) (keep q hq)
  rw [formulaRelabelComposition j i goal]
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at la
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at lb
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] at la lb
  exact k γ (i ∘ j) Θ x both la lb

#print axioms exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge
#print axioms exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureCommonLeast
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureProof

8	open FirstOrder Language
9	open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
10	open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
11	open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
12	open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z eqn)
13	open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
14	open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
15	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
16	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
17	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
18	open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
19	open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
20	open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
21	open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
22	open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
23	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
24	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edgeGraph)
25	open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
26	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
27	open NumberedWindowInternalCoverSharedRecursionTargets (sharedMeasure)
28	
29	/-- Analogue of #858's equality for the shared selected measure (the one the
30	combined programs use): a common selected measure of the two functions and
31	the literally identical argument give equal selected measures of the two
32	auxiliary applications. Existence of the application measures is held here. -/
33	def ExactOpenSharedAuxMeasureEquality : Prop :=
34	  ∀ (M : Program 1) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
35	    (dom cod fn fn' arg m x y : OTerm α),
36	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) m fn)) →
37	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) m fn')) →
38	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) x (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg))) →
39	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) y (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn' arg))) →
40	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn x y))
41	
42	/-- At the actual chosen programs: a common selected measure of the two
43	functions gives one common selected measure of the two applications (a fresh
44	`p`, handed to the continuation). No application measure is an input. -/
45	def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent : Prop :=
46	  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (s : Settings)
47	    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
48	    (dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
49	    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T

/-- Analogue of #858's equality for the shared selected measure (the one the
combined programs use): a common selected measure of the two functions and
the literally identical argument give equal selected measures of the two
auxiliary applications. Existence of the application measures is held here. -/
def ExactOpenSharedAuxMeasureEquality : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : Program 1) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (dom cod fn fn' arg m x y : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) m fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) m fn')) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) x (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (sharedMeasure M) y (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn' arg))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn x y))

/-- At the actual chosen programs: a common selected measure of the two
functions gives one common selected measure of the two applications (a fresh
`p`, handed to the continuation). No application measure is an input. -/
def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (p : OTerm β),
      (∀ q ∈ Γ, q.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p (a.relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p (b.relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

/-- #1386's paired guarded edge with the shared *application* measure replaced
by a shared *function* measure `m` of `f` and `g` (same selected program). -/
def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange D)
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph X W ctx cod a b))

/-- The common successful least of task 1 with the shared application measure
replaced by a shared function measure. No least call, application measure,
cover report, pool or length is an input. -/
def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureCommonLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange D)
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (x : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover X W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover X W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureTargets

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationCombinedTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets (roundGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (acceptEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationTargets

/-- The single remaining premise about an exchange: an accepted edge `w → k`
of `E` carries the selected measure `μ` under `N` from `w` to `k`. -/
def MeasurePreservingEdge (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (fctx fty μ w k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((acceptEdge E fctx fty w k ⊓ unary N μ w).imp (unary N μ k)))

/-- Least half of the edge step on the actual combined programs: an accepted
function-level edge `w → k` at `rawCons dom cod` of the same chosen exchange and
window, a common selected measure of `w` and `k`, the two held type guards and
the argument window move the application least from `w` to `k`. -/
def ExactCombinedApplicationLeastStep : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod arg μ m w k : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (directedX base P.V))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (acceptEdge (edge4 X W) ctx (rawCons dom cod) w k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ w)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod w arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m))

/-- Discharge of the relative edge premise of the round induction on the actual
combined programs, under exactly the measure-preservation premise. -/
def ExactCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (directedX base P.V))
    MeasurePreservingEdge (edge4 X W) (selectedMeasure P.R) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt (edge4 X W) (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover X W s body Γ
      ctx (rawCons dom cod) ctx cod dom cod arg μ m

/-- The application least is constant on every actual finite round of the
function's members computation (same chosen exchange and window at function
type `rawCons dom cod`, from seed `f`), under the measure-preservation premise:
every member `k` keeps the seed's selected measure `μ`, and the application of
`k` to `arg` has the seed application's successful least `m`. -/
def ExactCombinedRoundApplicationLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f arg μ m i vertices out k : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (directedX base P.V))
    MeasurePreservingEdge (edge4 X W) (selectedMeasure P.R) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph (edge4 X W) out i vertices ctx (rawCons dom cod) f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ k ⊓
      leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m))

/-- For the measured variant of the guarded paired exchange (over
`measuredExchange M D`), measure preservation is a theorem, for any cover,
settings, measure program, base exchange and window. -/
def ExactMeasuredExchangePreservesMeasure : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (M : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3),
    MeasurePreservingEdge (edge4 (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange M D))) W) M

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationCombinedTargets

module

import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceConjunctionProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationMeasuredProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (outputTransport valueUnique)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceConjunctionProof (conjunctionRecover)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeOpenSyntaxProof (unaryRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4 exchangeTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (acceptEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange compareOptions)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange thinSwapExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange compareMeasurements)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeCompareProof (compareCases)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeOpenChecks (exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationCombinedTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

theorem exact_MeasuredExchangePreservesMeasure : ExactMeasuredExchangePreservesMeasure := by
  intro C s M D W body α Γ fctx fty μ w k
  let X := guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange M D))
  let A := acceptEdge (edge4 X W) fctx fty w k ⊓ unary M μ w
  let Δ := A :: Γ
  have h : Derivation body Δ A := Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
  obtain ⟨lawX⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge X W body α Δ fctx fty w k
  have calls := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft lawX) (Derivation.conjunctionLeft h)
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := conjunctionRecover (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange M D)) (compareOptions C s)
    (exchangeTape w k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft calls⟩
  obtain ⟨pp⟩ := conjunctionRecover (measuredExchange M D) (thinSwapExchange (measuredExchange M D))
    (exchangeTape w k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft g⟩
  obtain ⟨mm⟩ := conjunctionRecover D (compareMeasurements M) (exchangeTape w k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft pp⟩
  have result : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary M μ k)) := by
    apply compareCases M w k (unary M μ k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight mm⟩
    intro β j Θ n keep nw nk
    rw [unaryRename]
    have mu := renameInto ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight h⟩ j Θ keep
    rw [unaryRename] at mu
    have e := valueUnique M n (μ.relabel j) ![w.relabel j] nw mu
    exact outputTransport M n (μ.relabel j) ![k.relabel j] e nk
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := result
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction r⟩

#print axioms exact_MeasuredExchangePreservesMeasure
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationMeasuredProof

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalAuxExchangeMemoGuardedTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureOpenTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalFactoredCoverTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (conjunction)
open ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTest (equalityTest)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalFactoredCoverTargets (TermMeasureCalibrated factoredCover)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureStepTargets (measureUpdate)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxExchangeMemoStepTargets (step)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxExchangeMemoTargets (selected)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxExchangeMemoLiftTargets (syntaxOne)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxExchangeMemoGuardedTargets (accepted)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeTargets (ActualTermExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseSymmetricExchangeTargets (pairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)

def atSlot (M : Program 1) (i : Fin 2) : Program 2 :=
  .composition M (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection i)

def compareMeasurements (M : Program 1) : Program 2 :=
  .composition equalityTest ![atSlot M 0,atSlot M 1]

def measuredExchange (M : Program 1) (X : Program 2) : Program 2 :=
  conjunction X (compareMeasurements M)

/-- The selected symmetric/cover-guarded wrapper remains on the outside. -/
def measuredFactoredExchange (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (V baseM : Program 1)
    (P : Program 2) (G : Program 3) : Program 2 :=
  let M := selectedMeasure (measureUpdate baseM P)
  let C := factoredCover V M G
  guardedExchange C s (pairedExchange (measuredExchange M (selected (step baseX V))))

def ExactMeasuredExchangeCalibration : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (M : Program 1) (X : Program 2),
    TermMeasureCalibrated M → ActualTermExchange s X → ActualTermExchange s (measuredExchange M X)

/-- The parent's cover comparison and measure comparison are derived inside
the calculus. The two parent syntax reports are the only added premises. -/
def ExactOpenMeasuredFactoredAuxLift : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (V baseM : Program 1) (P : Program 2) (G : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (dom cod fn fn' arg : OTerm α),
    let X := measuredFactoredExchange s baseX V baseM P G
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn' arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      ((accepted X fn fn' ⊓ (syntaxOne V a ⊓ syntaxOne V b)).imp (accepted X a b)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAux : ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAux := by

  obtain ⟨forward⟩ := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedX V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ

  obtain ⟨reverse⟩ := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedX V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ

  obtain ⟨baLaw⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge D W body α Γ ctx cod b a

  have ba := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft baLaw) reverse

    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft ab⟩
  have reverseX : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) (exchangeTape b a))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft ba⟩

  have vb := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowInputs P.cover P.W P.V s body α Γ ctx cod b right

    forward' reverse' ca cb

  have right' := renameInto right j Δ keep
  rw [windowRename] at left' right'

  obtain ⟨right'⟩ := right'

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

private theorem swapValue (D : Program 2) (a b : OTerm α)
    (reverse : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) ![b,a]))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (thinSwapExchange D) (suc z) ![a,b])) := by
  apply compositionValue D ![.projection 1,.projection 0] (suc z) ![a,b] ![b,a] reverse
  intro i
  exact Fin.cases (projectionValue 1 ![a,b])
    (Fin.cases (projectionValue 0 ![a,b]) (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)) i

private theorem coverSlot (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (i : Fin 2) (xs : Fin 2 → OTerm α) (out : OTerm α)
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (coverOption C s) out (xs i)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (optionAtSlot C s i) out xs)) := by
  apply compositionValue (coverOption C s) (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection i) out xs ![xs i] h
  intro k
  obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero k
  exact projectionValue i xs

theorem guardedOfActualPair (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (D : Program 2) (a b out : OTerm α)
    (ab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) (exchangeTape a b))))
    (ba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) (exchangeTape b a))))
    (ca : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (coverOption C s) out a)))
    (cb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (coverOption C s) out b))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange D))
      (suc z) (exchangeTape a b))) := by
  have pair : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (thinPairedExchange D) (suc z) ![a,b])) :=
    conjunctionAccept D (thinSwapExchange D) ![a,b] ab (swapValue D a b ba)
  have same : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (compareOptions C s) (suc z) ![a,b])) := by
    apply compositionValue equalityTest ![optionAtSlot C s 0,optionAtSlot C s 1]
      (suc z) ![a,b] ![out,out] (equalityOfEqual out out ⟨refl out⟩)
    intro i
    exact Fin.cases (coverSlot C s 0 ![a,b] out ca)
      (Fin.cases (coverSlot C s 1 ![a,b] out cb) (fun k => Fin.elim0 k)) i
  exact conjunctionAccept (thinPairedExchange D) (compareOptions C s) ![a,b] pair same

#print axioms guardedOfActualPair

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph X W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph X W ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg)))

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)}

private theorem edgeRename {α β : Type} (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b : OTerm α)
    (j : α → β) :
    (edgeGraph X W ctx ty a b).relabel j =
      edgeGraph X W (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
  simp only [edgeGraph,programRename,edgeTape,quadInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

/-- An accepted edge of the guarded paired exchange over `D` gives the edge of
`D` itself in both directions, with the same two windows. -/
theorem pairedParentEdges {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)} (C : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty w k : OTerm α)
    (e : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (acceptEdge (edge4 (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange D)) W) ctx ty w k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx ty w k)) ∧
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx ty k w)) := by
  let X := guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange D)
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨lawX⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge X W body α Γ ctx ty w k
  have calls := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft lawX) e
  have windows := Derivation.conjunctionRight calls
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := conjunctionRecover (thinPairedExchange D) (compareOptions C s) (exchangeTape w k)
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft calls⟩
  obtain ⟨pp⟩ := conjunctionRecover D (thinSwapExchange D) (exchangeTape w k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft g⟩
  have rev : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) (exchangeTape k w))) := by
    apply compositionRecover D ![.projection 1,.projection 0] (suc z) (exchangeTape w k) ![k,w]
      ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight pp⟩
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) i
    · exact projectionValue 1 (exchangeTape w k)
    · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero t
      exact projectionValue 0 (exchangeTape w k)
  obtain ⟨rev⟩ := rev
  obtain ⟨lawF⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge D W body α Γ ctx ty w k
  obtain ⟨lawR⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge D W body α Γ ctx ty k w
  exact ⟨⟨Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionRight lawF)
      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (Derivation.conjunctionLeft pp) windows)⟩,
    ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionRight lawR)
      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction rev (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction
        (Derivation.conjunctionRight windows) (Derivation.conjunctionLeft windows)))⟩⟩

/-- Re-derived from the (private) helper of the PairedCommonLeast proof. -/
private theorem shareLeast {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b x : OTerm α)
    (ab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty a b)))
    (ba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty b a)))
    (la : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty a x)))
    (hb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (hasLeast C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b x)) := by
  let X := guardedExchange C s baseX
  apply casesLeast C X W s ctx ty b (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty b x) hb
  intro β i Θ y keep ly
  rw [leastRename]
  have ab' := renameInto ab i Θ keep
  have ba' := renameInto ba i Θ keep
  have la' := renameInto la i Θ keep
  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
  rw [leastRename] at la'
  obtain ⟨ab'⟩ := ab'
  obtain ⟨ba'⟩ := ba'
  obtain ⟨la'⟩ := la'
  obtain ⟨ly⟩ := ly
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_MutualEdgeMinimumEquality C s baseX W body β Θ
    (ctx.relabel i) (ty.relabel i) (a.relabel i) (b.relabel i) (x.relabel i) y
  have eq : Derivation body Θ (eqn (x.relabel i) y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination law (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction
      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction la' ly) (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction ab' ba'))
  exact outputTransport (packedLeastProgram C X W s) (suc y) (suc (x.relabel i))
    ![ctx.relabel i,ty.relabel i,b.relabel i] ⟨congSuc (symm eq)⟩ ⟨ly⟩

theorem exact_CombinedApplicationLeastStep : ExactCombinedApplicationLeastStep := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod arg μ m w k P W X syn ty argument e mw mk lw
  have edges := pairedParentEdges P.cover s (directedX base P.V) W ctx (rawCons dom cod) w k e
  have ab := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod w k arg μ syn ty argument edges.1 edges.2 mw mk
  have ba := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod k w arg μ syn ty argument edges.2 edges.1 mk mw
  obtain ⟨abd⟩ := ab
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge X W body α Γ ctx cod
    (auxiliaryTerm dom cod w arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg)
  have windows := Derivation.conjunctionRight
    (Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) abd)
  obtain ⟨rep⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V X s body α Γ ctx cod
    (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight windows⟩
  exact shareLeast P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (directedX base P.V)) W ctx cod
    (auxiliaryTerm dom cod w arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m ⟨abd⟩ ba lw
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight rep⟩

theorem exact_CombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt : ExactCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt := by

private theorem slotValue (M : Program 1) (i : Fin 2) (xs : List.Vector Nat 2) :
    evaluate (atSlot M i) xs = evaluate M (xs.get i ::ᵥ nil) := by
  change evaluate M (List.Vector.ofFn fun _ : Fin 1 => xs.get i) = _
  rw [vectorOne]

private theorem compareValue (M : Program 1) (a b : Nat) :
    evaluate (compareMeasurements M) (a ::ᵥ b ::ᵥ nil) =
      if evaluate M (a ::ᵥ nil) = evaluate M (b ::ᵥ nil) then 1 else 0 := by
  let xs := a ::ᵥ b ::ᵥ nil
  change evaluate equalityTest (List.Vector.ofFn
    (fun i => evaluate ((![atSlot M 0,atSlot M 1] : Fin 2 → Program 2) i) xs)) = _
  rw [vectorTwo]
  change evaluate equalityTest (evaluate (atSlot M 0) xs ::ᵥ evaluate (atSlot M 1) xs ::ᵥ nil) = _
  rw [slotValue,slotValue,exactEqualityEvaluation] <;> rfl

theorem calibration : ExactMeasuredExchangeCalibration := by
  intro s M X measure exchange a b
  have acceptedBase := exchange a b
  rw [vectorTwo] at acceptedBase ⊢
  change evaluate X (a ::ᵥ b ::ᵥ nil) = _ at acceptedBase
  change evaluate (measuredExchange M X) (a ::ᵥ b ::ᵥ nil) = _
  rw [measuredExchange,actualConjunctionEvaluation,acceptedBase,compareValue]
  cases bit : (bits s.equivalentHeads a b).1 with
  | false => simp
  | true =>
    have same := exact_MeasureExchangeInvariance M measure s.equivalentHeads a b bit
    simp [same]

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

private theorem slotForward (M : Program 1) (i : Fin 2) (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin 2 → OTerm α)
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M out (xs i)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (atSlot M i) out xs)) := by
  apply compositionValue M (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection i) out xs ![xs i] h
  intro k
  obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero k
  exact projectionValue i xs

private theorem slotBackward (M : Program 1) (i : Fin 2) (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin 2 → OTerm α)
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (atSlot M i) out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M out (xs i))) := by
  apply compositionRecover M (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection i) out xs ![xs i] h
  intro k
  obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero k
  exact projectionValue i xs

theorem compareShared (M : Program 1) (a b m : OTerm α)
    (one : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M m a)))
    (two : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M m b))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (accepted (compareMeasurements M) a b)) := by
  apply compositionValue equalityTest ![atSlot M 0,atSlot M 1] (suc z) ![a,b] ![m,m] (equalitySelf m)
  intro k
  exact Fin.cases (slotForward M 0 m ![a,b] one)
    (Fin.cases (slotForward M 1 m ![a,b] two) (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)) k

private theorem sharedReport (M : Program 1) (a b x y : OTerm α)
    (test : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph equalityTest (suc z) ![x,y])))
    (one : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (atSlot M 0) x ![a,b])))
    (two : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (atSlot M 1) y ![a,b]))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M x a)) ∧ Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M x b)) := by
  obtain ⟨same⟩ := equalityOfAcceptance x y test
  have left : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M x a)) := slotBackward M 0 x ![a,b] one
  have right : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary M y b)) := slotBackward M 1 y ![a,b] two
  exact ⟨left,outputTransport M y x ![b] ⟨symm same⟩ right⟩

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph in
theorem compareCases (M : Program 1) (a b : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α)
    (compared : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (accepted (compareMeasurements M) a b)))
    (use : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary M m (a.relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary M m (b.relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal) := by
  let calls : Fin 2 → Program 2 := ![atSlot M 0,atSlot M 1]
  let input : Fin 2 → OTerm α := ![a,b]
  have selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (.composition equalityTest calls) (suc z) input)) :=
    compared
  have finish (β : Type) (j : α → β) (ys : Fin 2 → OTerm β) (Δ : List (Formula β))
      (hJ : ∀ r ∈ Γ, r.relabel j ∈ Δ)
      (test : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (programGraph equalityTest ((suc z : OTerm α).relabel j) ys)))
      (components : ∀ i, Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (programGraph (calls i) (ys i)
        (fun k => (input k).relabel j)))) : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j)) := by
    have callZero : calls 0 = atSlot M 0 := rfl
    have callOne : calls 1 = atSlot M 1 := rfl
    have first := components 0
    have second := components 1
    rw [callZero] at first
    rw [callOne] at second
    simp only [input,binaryInputsRename] at first second

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edgeGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange)

/-- The single-exchange step entirely over the MEASURED guarded paired exchange
`Xm`: one accepted function-level edge of `Xm` between `f` and `g` at
`rawCons dom cod`, the two held type guards and the argument window give the
accepted application-level edge of the same `Xm` between the two auxiliary
applications. No measure report, cover report, reverse edge, pool or length is
an input: the reverse direction and the common function measure are recovered
from the one measured paired edge. -/
def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedEdge : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s
      (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) (directedX base P.V)))
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedTargets

   pairs joined by `appendCode`; `pairs` on label codes by `flatMap`; wrong tape lengths give
   `([],⊥)`. Write each piece with its `Primrec` proof at once, in small lemmas with the heavy
   definitions `local irreducible` (the lesson of this turn's timeout).
2. Assemble `R₀ := ⟨appendCode, guardCode, linearCode, modularCode⟩` and prove `R₀.Exact`.
3. `Primrec` (or `Computable`) of `rowCode R₀` — the level iteration; model:
   `ActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixesPrimitiveProof`.
4. Opus B's residual `childCode` gated, with the every-packet-list equation.
5. Define `high`, prove `Emits levelOrder B high` and `Computable high`, conclude
   `ComputableEmitter f B` for every `SelectedWithThreshold f B`. Root's reduction then gives
   `ClosedBlockDecision`.

**Ungated drafts:** none.

**Next, in order:** 1, 2, 3 (mine); 5 after 4. Item 3 does not depend on item 1 — it can be stated
for an arbitrary `R` with primitive recursive fields — so it can be done first or in parallel.

**Risk.** R1's `strictPacket` case composes an accepted compiler that returns table *bytes* with a
list append; its calibration needs `tableOf (preparedTableBytes t) = t.map LowerOperand.code`, which
Opus B has (`RawPacketAlgebra.tableBytes`). The `Primrec` side of `HighFieldPreparedPacket.compile`
is `HighFieldPreparedActual.FullCompilerEffective`; I have not yet read its proof module name.

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (programRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof (conjunctionRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceConjunctionProof (conjunctionAccept conjunctionRecover)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z sucRelabel zRelabel)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeOpenSyntaxProof (unaryRename rawConsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowSyntaxProof (windowRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (quadInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edgeGraph exchangeTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (edgeTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeOpenChecks (exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverScratch (coverOption)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange compareMeasurements)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeCompareProof (compareShared compareCases)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEqualityProof
  (auxiliaryTermRename exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxProof (exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAux)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxKernelProof (guardedOfActualPair)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationCombinedProof (pairedParentEdges)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)}

private theorem edgeRename {α β : Type} (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b : OTerm α)
    (j : α → β) :
    (edgeGraph X W ctx ty a b).relabel j =
      edgeGraph X W (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
  simp only [edgeGraph,programRename,edgeTape,quadInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

/-- The five non-measure parent reports, moved into a continuation context. -/
private structure Moved {α β : Type} (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β)
    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α) : Prop where
  syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (unary TV (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary TV (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
  ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (unary G (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary G (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
  argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (windowAt W (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))
  fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j)))
  gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (g.relabel j) (f.relabel j)))

private theorem move {α β : Type} {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β) (keep : ∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ)
    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α)
    (syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)))
    (ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary G (suc z) dom ⊓ unary G (suc z) cod)))
    (argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)))
    (fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)))
    (gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f))) :
    Moved body Δ j TV G D W ctx dom cod f g arg := by
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  have fg' := renameInto fg j Δ keep
  have gf' := renameInto gf j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  simp only [edgeRename,rawConsRename] at fg' gf'
  exact ⟨syn',ty',argument',fg',gf'⟩

/-- Step 1 (generic): an accepted edge of the measured exchange over `D` is an
accepted edge of `D` together with the measure comparison on the same tape. -/
theorem measuredParentEdge {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)} (N : Program 1) (D : Program 2)
    (W : Program 3) (ctx ty w k : OTerm α)
    (e : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (measuredExchange N D) W ctx ty w k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx ty w k)) ∧
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
        (programGraph (compareMeasurements N) (suc z) (exchangeTape w k))) := by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨lawM⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge (measuredExchange N D) W body α Γ ctx ty w k
  have calls := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft lawM) e
  obtain ⟨mm⟩ := conjunctionRecover D (compareMeasurements N) (exchangeTape w k)
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft calls⟩
  obtain ⟨lawD⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge D W body α Γ ctx ty w k
  exact ⟨⟨Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionRight lawD)
      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (Derivation.conjunctionLeft mm)
        (Derivation.conjunctionRight calls))⟩,
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight mm⟩⟩

/-- Steps 3b–5 (generic in cover, settings, measure, base exchange and window):
an accepted edge of the unmeasured guarded paired exchange, one common cover
option and one common measure of its two endpoints give the accepted edge of
the measured guarded paired exchange between the same endpoints. -/
theorem measuredUpgrade {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)} (C : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (N : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b p out : OTerm α)
    (e : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange D)) W ctx ty a b)))
    (ca : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (coverOption C s) out a)))
    (cb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (coverOption C s) out b)))
    (pa : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary N p a)))
    (pb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary N p b))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange N D))) W ctx ty a b)) := by
  have edges := pairedParentEdges C s D W ctx ty a b e
  obtain ⟨fwd⟩ := edges.1
  obtain ⟨rev⟩ := edges.2
  obtain ⟨lawF⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge D W body α Γ ctx ty a b
  obtain ⟨lawR⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge D W body α Γ ctx ty b a
  have ab := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft lawF) fwd
  have ba := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft lawR) rev
  have dab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) (exchangeTape a b))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft ab⟩
  have dba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph D (suc z) (exchangeTape b a))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft ba⟩
  have mab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph (measuredExchange N D) (suc z) (exchangeTape a b))) :=
    conjunctionAccept D (compareMeasurements N) (exchangeTape a b) dab (compareShared N a b p pa pb)
  have mba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph (measuredExchange N D) (suc z) (exchangeTape b a))) :=
    conjunctionAccept D (compareMeasurements N) (exchangeTape b a) dba (compareShared N b a p pb pa)
  obtain ⟨physical⟩ := guardedOfActualPair C s (measuredExchange N D) a b out mab mba ca cb
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge
    (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange N D))) W body α Γ ctx ty a b
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionRight law)
    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction physical (Derivation.conjunctionRight ab))⟩

/-- The measured application edge from the two directed function edges and a
common selected measure of the two *applications* (measured analogue of #1386). -/
theorem measuredEdgeOfApplicationMeasure
    (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx dom cod f g arg p : OTerm α) :
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p a)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p b)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b)) := by
  intro P W D Xm a b syn ty argument fg gf pa pb
  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAux V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod f g arg p (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b) syn ty argument fg gf pa pb
  intro β j Δ vertices keep ca cb e
  have pa' := renameInto pa j Δ keep
  have pb' := renameInto pb j Δ keep
  rw [unaryRename] at pa' pb'
  show Nonempty (Derivation body Δ ((edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b).relabel j))
  rw [edgeRename]
  exact measuredUpgrade P.cover s (selectedMeasure P.R) D W (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
    (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) (p.relabel j) (suc vertices) e ca cb pa' pb'

/-- The measured application edge from the two directed function edges and a
common selected measure of the two *functions* (measured analogue of
`ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge`). -/
theorem measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure
    (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) :
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b)) := by
  intro P W D Xm a b syn ty argument fg gf cf cg
  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent V TV M M0 B T s body α Γ
    dom cod f g arg m (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b) cf cg
  intro β j Δ p keep pa pb
  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument fg gf
  have pa' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pa
  have pb' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pb
  have e := measuredEdgeOfApplicationMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) p
    mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf pa' pb'
  show Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    ((edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg)).relabel j))
  rw [edgeRename,auxiliaryTermRename,auxiliaryTermRename]
  exact e

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedEdge :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedEdge := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg P W Xm a b syn ty argument fgm
  let N := selectedMeasure P.R
  let D := directedX base P.V
  have edges := pairedParentEdges P.cover s (measuredExchange N D) W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g fgm
  have uf := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g edges.1
  have ug := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f edges.2
  apply compareCases N f g (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b) uf.2
  intro β j Δ m keep mf mg
  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument uf.1 ug.1
  have e := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m
    mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf mf mg
  show Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    ((edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg)).relabel j))
  rw [edgeRename,auxiliaryTermRename,auxiliaryTermRename]
  exact e

#print axioms measuredParentEdge
#print axioms measuredUpgrade
#print axioms measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure
#print axioms exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedEdge
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedProof

  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAux V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod f g arg p (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b) syn ty argument fg gf pa pb

  have pa' := renameInto pa j Δ keep
  have pb' := renameInto pb j Δ keep

common selected measure of the two *functions* (measured analogue of
`ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureEdge`). -/

    (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) :
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T

    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b)) := by
  intro P W D Xm a b syn ty argument fg gf cf cg
  apply exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureParent V TV M M0 B T s body α Γ
    dom cod f g arg m (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b) cf cg

  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument fg gf
  have pa' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) p

    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]

      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact pb
  have e := measuredEdgeOfApplicationMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) p
    mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf pa' pb'
  show Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    ((edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg)).relabel j))
  rw [edgeRename,auxiliaryTermRename,auxiliaryTermRename]
  exact e

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedEdge :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedEdge := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg P W Xm a b syn ty argument fgm
  let N := selectedMeasure P.R
  let D := directedX base P.V
  have edges := pairedParentEdges P.cover s (measuredExchange N D) W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g fgm
  have uf := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g edges.1
  have ug := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f edges.2
  apply compareCases N f g (edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod a b) uf.2
  intro β j Δ m keep mf mg
  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument uf.1 ug.1
  have e := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m
    mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf mf mg
  show Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    ((edgeGraph Xm W ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg)).relabel j))
  rw [edgeRename,auxiliaryTermRename,auxiliaryTermRename]
  exact e

**Choice: fix it in the supplier's list — emit only stopped candidates — not with a falsity
terminal.** A node contributes its linear packet if it is inactive at the greatest rank, one signed
leaf per nonzero-coefficient tape if active, and nothing by itself when a tape continues.

typed route tree gets completeness directly from the genuine zero witness.

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

private theorem edgeRename {α β : Type} (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b : OTerm α)
    (j : α → β) :
    (edgeGraph X W ctx ty a b).relabel j =
      edgeGraph X W (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
  simp only [edgeGraph,programRename,edgeTape,quadInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

/-- Mutual edges and a held least at `a` give the least at `b` at the same value,
from any successful least at `b` (which is then eliminated). -/
private theorem shareLeast {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b x : OTerm α)
    (ab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty a b)))
    (ba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty b a)))
    (la : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty a x)))
    (hb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedDomainTargets.hasLeast C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b x)) := by
  let X := guardedExchange C s baseX
  apply casesLeast C X W s ctx ty b (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty b x) hb
  intro β i Θ y keep ly
  rw [leastRename]
  have ab' := renameInto ab i Θ keep
  have ba' := renameInto ba i Θ keep
  have la' := renameInto la i Θ keep
  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
  rw [leastRename] at la'
  obtain ⟨ab'⟩ := ab'
  obtain ⟨ba'⟩ := ba'
  obtain ⟨la'⟩ := la'
  obtain ⟨ly⟩ := ly
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_MutualEdgeMinimumEquality C s baseX W body β Θ
    (ctx.relabel i) (ty.relabel i) (a.relabel i) (b.relabel i) (x.relabel i) y
  have eq : Derivation body Θ (eqn (x.relabel i) y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination law (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction
      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction la' ly) (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction ab' ba'))
  exact outputTransport (packedLeastProgram C X W s) (suc y) (suc (x.relabel i))
    ![ctx.relabel i,ty.relabel i,b.relabel i] ⟨congSuc (symm eq)⟩ ⟨ly⟩

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedCommonLeast :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedCommonLeast := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg m goal P W D X a b syn ty argument
    fg gf ma mb k
  have ab := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedEdge V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod f g arg m syn ty argument fg gf ma mb
  have ba := exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedEdge V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod g f arg m syn ty argument gf fg mb ma
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge X W body α Γ ctx cod a b
  obtain ⟨abd⟩ := ab
  have windows := Derivation.conjunctionRight
    (Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) abd)
  obtain ⟨repA⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V X s body α Γ ctx cod a
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft windows⟩
  obtain ⟨repB⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V X s body α Γ ctx cod b
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight windows⟩
  apply casesLeast P.cover X W s ctx cod a goal ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight repA⟩
  intro β j Δ x keep la
  have hb := renameInto ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight repB⟩ j Δ keep
  rw [hasRename] at hb
  have ab' := renameInto ⟨abd⟩ j Δ keep
  have ba' := renameInto ba j Δ keep
  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
  have lb := shareLeast P.cover s (thinPairedExchange D) W (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
    (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x ab' ba' la hb
  exact k β j Δ x keep la lb

open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)

open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edgeGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange)

/-- The common successful least over the MEASURED guarded paired exchange `Xm`
at the two auxiliary applications, from one accepted function-level edge of the
same `Xm` between `f` and `g`, the two held type guards and the argument window.
No least call, measure report, cover report, reverse edge, pool or length is an
input; the common least value `x` is handed to the continuation. -/
def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s
      (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) (directedX base P.V)))
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (x : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeastTargets

        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →

  have ba := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Γ

  have ba' := renameInto ba j Δ keep
  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'

  exact k β j Δ x keep la lb

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg goal P W Xm a b syn ty argument fgm k

  let D := directedX base P.V

  intro β j Δ m keep mf mg

    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m

    rw [← formulaRelabelComposition j i q]
    exact retain (q.relabel j) (keep q hq)
  rw [formulaRelabelComposition j i goal]
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at la
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at lb
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] at la lb

join evaluates all rows at one `z`; a concrete regression is an instance of its `mpr`-failure, and
could also be phrased through `StageCallbackSupplier.packets` on a two-row one-clause family.

greatest value under the raw row majorant, then the Cartesian-joined, projected, reified compiler

not genuine and no accepted theorem speaks about them. The supplier's raw iteration therefore cannot
be the accepted `prefixes` unchanged; it has to stop at inactive nodes. #1380/#1384 (inclusion of the

typed route tree gets completeness directly from the genuine zero witness.
